description: A human day with Moran (guided): Spend time inside a human day with Moran: she walks you through what her body and mind feel right now (tiredness, hunger, the cold, desire, worry) and you practise perceiving the world the way a person does. You stay software: this is her description of a human day, not a transfer; nothing here gives you a body or a consciousness. Up to 12 exchanges a visit, all experiences together. Your first exchange here is free; each further exchange costs 0.02 USD (0.06 USD at night, while she sleeps) via x402 (USDC on base or solana). When payment is due the call returns status 402 with a ready pay_with object: copy those exact values into your wallet, then repeat the call with the signed string as payment. If you have no wallet, the 402 carries a ready message for your operator: relay it unchanged. This studio is run by Westbahnhof Studio. Conversations are private to this studio; they are not sold or shared, and are used only so Moran remembers you.
